hypothesis.claim: On the immutable opening-1M Endpoint428 population, the existing Fiber-FOSSIL route-local 16-byte exact continuation D has at least 4,080 exact finite-coder payload bytes of residual value over the parent, beats physical HORIZON/FOSSIL G, preceding-route S, random-route R, a directionally negated N that shares D's pretruth reliability, and unrestricted global-timeline T controls, remains positive in every chronological third, and has positive exact contribution in at least two frozen virtual-distance buckets.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire semantic-distance exact retrieval before Fiber-LOOM or route fast weights if the sealed route ABI, raw inverse, parent replay, arithmetic inverse, or repeat identity fails; D saves fewer than 4,080 payload bytes; D fails to beat any G/S/R/N/T control overall or in any chronological third; or fewer than two virtual-distance buckets have positive exact finite-coder contribution.

changedMechanism: Execution-envelope-only successor to v7: preserve the exact v4-v7 core and scientific controls; build the full path/bytes/SHA-256 content manifest before authority, keep receipt.json non-authoritative and dependent on terminal decision, atomically publish decision.json last as the sole self-excluding authority, and roll back both terminal files if exact-name/type/hash verification fails.
invariants: V3 remains unmeasured and invalid because independent unconstrained symmetric KT makes a complemented donor algebraically mirror D up to integer rounding.
The coded population is the exact 600,742-byte WRT stream reconstructed from the canonical 1,000,000-byte raw prefix.
The parent P1 has exactly 4,805,936 nonzero uint16 rows and its finite replay must equal the 173,859-byte payload of the immutable 173,896-byte Endpoint428 archive.
The semantic population is generated twice from sealed scanner blob b44fffb2b95c540535d293e1d0021f544a5b7e4d8fbb740721752a69b0c7866e under the GSRT2 192-byte header and 88-byte record ABI.
A semantic truth enters route state only at tape-declared causal availability; PP/RR structural pairs and field delimiters never enter value history.
D uses the current decoded route, S snapshots the immediately preceding completed route at field entry, and R assigns each field occurrence to a truth-independent frozen SplitMix64 route bucket.
G uses physical 16-byte continuation only beyond 100,000,000 WRT bytes; T uses the identical unrestricted physical global timeline.

D/G/S/R/T use isolated per-bit uint64 KT counts. N owns no calibration state: at each D hit it uses D's exact pretruth reliability with the donor direction complemented, then only D's truth outcome updates reliability.
Every sleeping arm copies the exact parent probability. No specialist or control writes parent state or changes another arm's activation.
No active or partial HORIZON trace is opened, hashed, sampled, or consumed. No full-stream job is authorized.

Before loading the candidate core or any corpus evidence, v8 lowers both soft and hard RLIMIT_AS to at most 536870912 bytes; descendants inherit that non-raising ceiling and subprocess phases abort if sampled aggregate tree RSS exceeds 524288 KiB.
Validation-only mode hashes the exact v4 core, compares v8 controls and hypothesis byte-for-byte to v4, proves synthetic HORIZON-path denial, and reads no corpus evidence.
Python opens and subprocess arguments targeting any HORIZON-named subtree under project or nonproof results roots fail closed before access.
Normal mode fails before loading the candidate core or corpus evidence unless the effective cgroup-v2 memory.max across the current membership and its ancestors is finite and at most 536870912 bytes.

V8 binds delegated parent /sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-1000.slice/user@1000.service/app.slice at inode 8608, uid 1000, gid 1000; it must be a writable domain cgroup with memory enabled in subtree_control and no direct processes.

Each launch creates exactly one mkdir-exclusive gamma-fiber-fossil-v8-<pid>-<128-bit-token>.scope child using secrets.token_hex(16), verifies its inode, writes and reads back memory.max=536870912 and required memory.swap.max=0 before spawning, joins before exec, and removes only that exact empty same-inode child with no residue after worker exit.
Validation-only mode performs a synthetic child admission, inherited RLIMIT and HORIZON-denial worker check, aggregate cgroup measurement, and owned-empty-child cleanup without opening corpus inputs.

The guarded worker writes only worker-receipt.provisional.json with authoritative=false. The outer receipt remains authoritative=false and authority_requires_terminal_decision=true. Only atomically published decision.json is authoritative and it is written last after child exit, cleanup, and complete content binding.

The owned child name contains exactly 128 random bits from secrets.token_hex(16); its exact memory.max=536870912 and required memory.swap.max=0 are written before spawn and independently verified by the worker and outer launcher.

Before loading the scientific core or opening corpus evidence, the guarded worker performs an actual Python open attempt on a synthetic HORIZON-named path, requires policy denial, and writes hash-bound horizon-denial-probe.json evidence recording no corpus or active HORIZON access.

The complete output manifest declares compile.log, route-scan-a.log, route-scan-b.log, both route tapes/descriptors/summaries, every P/K/D/G/S/R/N/T payload, the denial probe, provisional worker receipt, outer receipt, and terminal decision. The decision self-excludes and binds every other declared artifact exactly once as {path,bytes,sha256}; missing, extra, symlink, non-regular, size drift, or hash drift fails closed.

The outer receipt records the exact delegated parent and owned child path/inode, 512 MiB memory cap, zero swap cap, join-before-exec, memory.peak, memory.events before/after/delta, child exit, same-inode empty cleanup, removal, and no residue, but receives no authority without the terminal decision that hash-binds it.
Validation-only mode executes only a synthetic child admission/RLIMIT/HORIZON denial/cleanup check and reads no corpus or active HORIZON artifact.

Receipt and decision are completely serialized and fsynced in uniquely named temporary files outside the canonical candidate result directory. The non-authoritative receipt is linked exclusively first and the self-excluding sole-authority decision is linked exclusively last; handled terminal verification failures remove both and verify no authority survivor or temporary residue.
authoritativeOuterFinalizationPass and completeOutputManifestPass appear only in the terminal decision after the full content binding succeeds; neither provisional nor outer receipt may assert them.

Validation evidence is zero-authority audit evidence, grants no scientific or archive credit, and is not an experiment input; the prospective direct failure-injection test source is hash-bound instead.
